messages.text:
Hi all - quick context on the tech screen since Davut mentioned some confusion around it.

The exercise is intentionally open ended. The idea is less about building a perfect model and more about seeing how candidates frame the problem, deal with messy/incomplete data, and explain their reasoning. That’s closer to the environment we operate in.

The dataset itself is actually based on the same TNM engagement problem we originally explored with Jaan (Redsella) early on. For the tech screen I trimmed it down quite a bit so the file sizes stay manageable and candidates aren’t overwhelmed by the full dataset.

It’s meant to be a time-boxed exercise (roughly a few hours). Some candidates go deeper depending on how they scope the problem, which is fine too - but the intention isn’t to build a full production model.

When I put this exercise together the goal was mainly to see how candidates think through ambiguity and communicate their approach, since that tends to mirror the kind of work we’ll be doing here.

Happy for Jaan to talk it through with Davut as well. Since he’s already familiar with the underlying problem space, that context might actually help.
